title: $q$-Berezin Range of Operators in Hardy Space
summary: This paper investigates the concept of the $q$-Berezin range and $q$-Berezin number of bounded linear operators acting on Hardy space. We obtain the $q$-Berezin range of some classes of operators on Hardy space. In addition, the convexity of the $q$-Berezin range is explored for finite-rank, diagonal, multiplication, weighted shift, and certain composition operators.
